name: Sapa
provinceNote: From 1 July 2025, phường Sa Pa joins six former wards. The valley communes are xã Tả Van, xã Tả Phìn, and xã Bản Hồ. Xã Lao Chải was not merged.
dotReason: Worth a special trip in this corridor
summary: A mountain town in northern Vietnam above valleys of rice terraces, at the foot of Fansipan. Hike to villages such as Cat Cat and Ta Phin, ride the cable car up Fansipan, see the stone church, and eat grilled street food and salmon hotpot. One or two nights suits hikers and families.
timeNeeded: One night, or more if you walk the valley and ride the cable car
fee: No single town ticket. Cat Cat scenic fee from 1 Jan 2025: 10,000 đồng from age 16, 5,000 đồng from over 6 to under 16. Village gate on two commercial pages: adult 150,000 đồng, child 70,000 đồng, and the child heights do not match. Scenic fee and gate are different charges. Do not add them. Cat Cat hours: 06:30–18:00, 07:00–18:00, and 6:30–17:30. Lao Chải–Tả Van gate, 2023 table: adult 75,000 đồng, child 50,000 đồng. Tả Phìn–Sín Chải–Hầu Thào: 40,000 đồng and 20,000 đồng. Fansipan ride: about 15 minutes, 15–20 minutes, and 30 minutes. Out-of-province adult 750,000 đồng on the operator page dated 20 Aug 2018, and 850,000 đồng in the 2026 guide. Summit scenic fee 10,000 đồng from age 16. Clocks: 7:30am–5:30pm every day; 07:30–17:00; a 28 Sep 2026 notice sets different last departures by weekday. Weather can close the line. Church dated 1895, and also the early 20th century. Đức Mẹ Mân Côi is also the name. Ham Rong, begun 1996: nearly 150 ha and nearly 1,800 m, and 148 ha. Adult 70,000 đồng. Child lines: under 1.2 m at 20,000 đồng, with no price for a taller child; over 1.2 m at 30,000 đồng and under 1.2 m free; 1 m–1.4 m at 30,000 đồng and under 1 m free, with 06:00–18:00 on that page. National-page hours: Check on arrival. Saturday market hour: Check on arrival. Breakfast hour: Check on arrival. Rail fares: Check on arrival. Minutes on the Lao Cai climb: Check on arrival. Motorbike rule: Check on arrival. Muong Hoa funicular fare: Check on arrival.
getThere: Night train to Lao Cai, then the climb. A bus into town is 5–6 hours, or 5–7 hours. Sa Pa is 38 km southwest of Lao Cai city. The QL4D climb is also given as more than 30 km. Minutes on that road: Check on arrival. Fares: Check on arrival. Sa Pa airport is not open. Fly into Nội Bài.
bestMonths: September–October for the terraces, April–May for clearer days, and also Sep–Nov.
seoTitle: Sapa travel guide — rice terraces, Cat Cat and Ta Phin, Fansipan
seoDescription: Wake to rice terraces under the ridge, trek to Cat Cat and Ta Phin, and ride the cable car to Fansipan from Nguyễn Chí Thanh. Saturday evening is the market in front of the stone church.
intro: You wake above the rice terraces, stepped fields under the town and the ridge beyond them, then walk out to Cat Cat and Ta Phin, where Mong, Giay, and Red Dao communities live among the paddies.

The stone church is the pin in the center. Ham Rong, the garden hill, is behind it. Fansipan is the cable car from Nguyễn Chí Thanh, then the pagoda and the last steps. Lodges and homestays sit out among the terraces as well as in the hub. Weather can close the cable line.

Cat Cat is the closest of those walks. Ta Van is farther down the valley, about 12 km from the center, a walk of 8–12 km in 3–5 hours. The older route is town–Ý Linh Hồ–Lao Chải–Tả Van. Xã Lao Chải was not merged in 2025.

Saturday evening is the market in town and in the square in front of the church, where Hmong and Dao families gather to trade. Other cold nights, the grills are at hồ Sa Pa and on the road down to the market.
gettingAround: The train ends at Ga Lào Cai. From 10 October 2026 the night trains are SP15 21:45–05:20, SP3 22:00–05:50, and SP7 22:40–06:27. Return is SP16 21:25–05:15, SP4 21:50–05:40, and daytime SP8 12:05–19:30. A 2015 timetable lists SP1 at 21:40–05:30 and SP3 at 22:00–06:10. That is an older board.

Sa Pa is 38 km southwest of Lao Cai city. The QL4D climb is also given as more than 30 km. The provincial road 155 connector is 13.8 km. The Mong Sen section shortens the old road by about 2.5 km. Another measure shortens the trip by about 7 km and 20 minutes. TL155 is one-way from Sa Pa toward Lao Cai. QL4D stays both ways.

In town, walk or take a taxi. Mountain bikes are rented for valley trails. Cat Cat and Ta Phin can be walked without a guide. An overnight trek is a separate booking. Nguyễn Chí Thanh is the Fansipan road. The Muong Hoa funicular, about five minutes from Sun Plaza to Hoang Lien station, is not the train from Hanoi. Sa Pa airport is not open. Fly into Nội Bài.

stayAreas.name: Town around the church
stayAreas.summary: Sleep here when you want the square, the Saturday market, and the road to the cable car on foot. Cầu Mây is the street of shopfronts in the hub.

stayAreas.name: Terraces outside the hub
stayAreas.summary: Sleep here when the morning should be the fields. Lodges and homestays sit among the terraces.

eat: Thắng cố, the grills at hồ Sa Pa, and the salmon at Silver Waterfall are the meals. Doors and hours are on the food guide.
interestsBody: The valley terraces are the picture under the town. Fansipan is the cable car. Cat Cat is the nearest village walk, and Ta Phin is the other. The stone church is the square in the center.
Saturday evening is the market, with Hmong and Dao families trading in the square. Other cold nights, eat at the grills by the lake.

blocks.heading: Saturday market
paragraphs: Saturday evening, Hmong and Dao families gather to trade in the town market and in the square in front of the stone church. The new market’s food floor, upstairs, serves noodles, phở, and rice. Cầu Mây is the street of shopfronts in the hub.

body: Muong Hoa is the named valley, 8 km southeast at Hầu Thào. The fields are still farmed, and the rice turns through late summer into autumn. September–October, Sep–Nov, mid-August until early September, and about mid-August to October are all given for that colour.

interestGroups.title: Walking villages
interestGroups.summary: Cat Cat is the nearest walk. Ta Phin is the other village you can see without a guide.

blocks.heading: Cat Cat
paragraphs: The village is named both thôn Cát Cát, xã Tả Van, and San Sả Hồ commune. The 2025 xã Tả Van absorbed xã Hoàng Liên, which is where the scenic-fee decision still places the waterfall. Hours are given as 06:30–18:00, as 07:00–18:00, and as 6:30–17:30.

blocks.heading: Farther down the valley
paragraphs: The older route is town–Ý Linh Hồ–Lao Chải–Tả Van. Ta Van is about 12 km from the center, a walk of 8–12 km in 3–5 hours, with Mong, Giay, and Red Dao communities. Xã Lao Chải was not merged in 2025. The Lao Chải–Tả Van gate is 75,000 đồng for an adult and 50,000 đồng for a child on a 2023 table. Ta Phin is the other village. Tả Phìn–Sín Chải–Hầu Thào is 40,000 đồng and 20,000 đồng on that same table.

interestGroups.title: The stone church square
interestGroups.summary: The church in the center, and Ham Rong behind it.
body: The church stands on a plot of about 6,000 m², Roman Gothic, with a bell tower of 20 m and a 1932 bell of about 1.5 m and 500 kg. It is dated 1895, and also to the early 20th century. Saturday evening the square is where the gathering is. Christmas is named without a civil date.

Ham Rong is the park beside the church, begun in 1996. The area is nearly 150 ha and nearly 1,800 m, and also 148 ha. The adult fee is 70,000 đồng. The child line is not one figure: under 1.2 m at 20,000 đồng, with no price for a taller child; over 1.2 m at 30,000 đồng and under 1.2 m free; 1 m–1.4 m at 30,000 đồng and under 1 m free. One clock is 06:00–18:00.

cards.title: Stone church
cards.summary: The stone church and the square in front of it.

faqs.a: In town, around the stone church, when you want the square and the Saturday market on foot. Out among the terraces when the valley is the morning.

faqs.q: How long is the bus from Hanoi?
faqs.a: A bus into the center is 5–6 hours, or 5–7 hours. The road after the train, from Lao Cai, is the climb of 38 km, also given as more than 30 km.

faqs.q: Which Fansipan clock and ticket do I use?
faqs.a: Clocks in use are 7:30am–5:30pm every day, 07:30–17:00, and a 28 September 2026 notice with different last departures by weekday. An out-of-province adult is 750,000 đồng on the 20 August 2018 operator page and 850,000 đồng in the 2026 guide. Weather can close the line.
Saturday evening, in the town market and in the square in front of the church. Hmong and Dao families gather there to trade.

season.label: Terrace months
season.note: September and October for the terraces, and also Sep–Nov. April and May for clearer weather. June to August if you can take the heat. November to March is chilly, with frost around Fansipan. Rice is also given as mid-August until early September, as September, and as about mid-August to October. Landslides on the old QL4D climb are why the connector was built.
